title: An indirect network effect
caption: More drivers mean shorter waits; shorter waits attract more riders; more riders attract more drivers. Each side makes the platform more valuable to the other, which is why a platform must win both sides at launch.
alt: A cycle of three boxes: more drivers, shorter waits, more riders, with more riders leading back to more drivers.
description: The new app pays drivers bonuses, so more drivers join.
More riders attract more drivers, and the loop repeats.
